# Nootle

> AI-powered meeting recorder for Mac. Records, transcribes in real time with speaker identification, and enables AI chat about meetings. Recording and transcription are always local — AI summaries and chat are only fully local when paired with a local model via Ollama.

## Product

- Platform: macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon (M1–M5)
- Price: Free (open source, MIT license)
- Download: https://github.com/michellemayes/nootle/releases
- Website: https://nootle.ai
- GitHub: https://github.com/michellemayes/nootle

## Features

- Records without a bot joining the call
- Real-time transcription with speaker diarization using Parakeet via ONNX Runtime
- Speaker names read from the call window, and optional voice memory that names people in later meetings
- AI summaries and chat (supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Groq, OpenRouter, AWS Bedrock, local Ollama, and Claude / ChatGPT subscriptions via the Claude Code and Codex CLIs)
- Local-only mode, and no telemetry
- Knowledge base: index project folders, documents (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Markdown, CSV, HTML), and web pages on your Mac
- Live Assist: answers questions from your documents and past meetings during a call
- Snapshots of shared slides, designs, and charts, with on-device text recognition
- Shorthand notes expanded into full notes after the meeting
- "What did I miss?" recap of the last five minutes
- Meeting detection for Zoom, Teams, Webex, Slack, FaceTime, Discord, and browser calls like Google Meet
- Calendar: upcoming meetings with one-click Record and Join
- Import audio/video recordings and transcripts from Otter, Fathom, Granola, Zoom, Teams, or Meet
- Meaning-based and keyword search across all meetings and documents
- Customizable summary templates that run automatically
- Workflows that push summaries and action items to: Slack, Notion, Linear, GitHub, Confluence, Asana, Obsidian, Email
- Export as Markdown, text, SRT, or WebVTT
- CLI tool for querying meeting data from the terminal
- MCP server for AI assistant integration
- Automatic action item extraction
- Auto-titling of meetings from transcript content

## How It Works

1. Nootle detects when a call starts on Zoom, Teams, Webex, Slack, FaceTime, Discord, or in the browser
2. Records and transcribes on your Mac in real time with speaker identification
3. Live Assist answers questions from your documents and past meetings during the call
4. Generates AI summaries, expands your notes, and lets you ask follow-up questions
5. Pushes notes to Slack, Linear, Notion, or other connected tools

## Privacy

Audio recording and transcription always happen locally on your Mac using ONNX Runtime. No meeting audio is ever uploaded, and transcripts are stored only on the local device. AI summaries and chat use whichever provider the user picks: Ollama keeps everything on-device, while OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Groq, OpenRouter, or AWS Bedrock send transcript context to that provider using the user's own API key. Nootle is fully local end-to-end only when paired with a local AI model.
